title: Understanding the Derivative
text: The derivative of TUO with respect to $$\theta_0$$ involves a summation over all customers. Notice how each term in the summation has a fraction involving the tip and $$\theta_0$$. What happens when you set this derivative to zero?

title: Balancing the Equation
text: To find the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes TUO, consider setting the derivative equal to zero. This will help you find the critical points. What does the equation look like when you do this?

title: Solving for $$\Theta_0$$
text: Once you have set the derivative to zero, try isolating $$\theta_0$$. Think about how you can manipulate the equation to express $$\theta_0$$ in terms of the tips.
